eoe.text: Kavaron is the Kav homeworld, a planet that is falling apart because the Kav's mining for moxite shattered it into two halves, and their appetite for mining is also the only means by which they can lift their civilization from it.
On Exodus Day the first Kav shuttle lifts the first refugees off its unstable surface, and decades later the Kav are still leaving as the world crumbles into space.

Sami and Tannuk fly the Seriema through the Mordraine Ring toward Kavaron That Is to find a stasis cask for their prize, only to see the Hopelight blowtorch Tan's cache site and crash, and Kav of the Memorial Navy surround the wreck and accuse Tannuk of violating his exile.
Sami and Tannuk save Alpharael, then flee Kavaron as the Summists pursue, and the Guns of Kavaron fire on the pursuing Hopelight.
